text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD12345 fired for service inference-prod-us-west — p99 latency > 800ms for 5m, p95 elevated. Paging oncall rotation.

mike: Acked PD12345 — I’m taking lead. Pulling up dashboards now.

sara: Seeing p95 jump too, seems concentrated in us-west1 zone. KV-cache evictions spiking and tokenizer queue depth rising.

mike: Confirmed model-workers cpu at ~100% in us-west. Autoscaler didn't add because pool autoscale disabled. I’m going to manual scale.

mike: Ran:
```
kubectl scale deployment inference-workers --replicas=20 -n prod-us-west
```

incident-bot: Autoscale policy note: autoscale disabled for pool "low-latency" since 03:00 UTC for maintenance.

ashley: That explains it. Can we enable regional fallthrough to eu temporarily while we stabilize?

raj: I can open fallback routing and bump dedicated burst capacity. Rolling now (30% traffic to eu fallback, gradual).
```
# control-plane call (sanitized)
curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/route -d '{"from":"us-west","to":"eu-west","pct":30}'
```

mike: Also starting a small-model rollout to reduce tail and warm KV cache.

mike: `deployctl rollout model inference-quant:rev42 --weight 10% --region us-west`

emily: Customer-impact snapshot: top chat customers in APAC proxied through us-west seeing slower responses and increased retries. CS alerted; prepping comms.

sara: Tokenizer pod shows backlog on us-west1-a, I'm going to restart one pod to clear the queue.

sara: Restart done — tokenization latency dropping, KV hit-rate improving.

mike: p95 down from ~780ms -> ~420ms over last 90s after scale + restart. p99 still ~620ms.

incident-bot: PD alert update: p99 at 620ms — still above SLO threshold. Monitoring window extended. Next escalation at +15m if not recovered.

ashley: Can we reduce batch size for the large model to reduce tail latency? Suggest toggling feature flag for us-west only.

raj: Toggled `model.batch_limit` to 8 for rev43 in us-west.
`/ops/flags set model.batch_limit 8 --scope=us-west`

mike: After batch change + routing, p99 trending down to ~420ms. This looks like stabilization.

mike: Handing off to SRE rotation for monitoring and follow-up. Leaving note: revert eu fallback when stable, confirm autoscale re-enable post-maint.

sara: Ack handoff — will monitor for 30m and call if any regression.

emily: CS: drafting status for impacted customers, grouping by orgs with >1% error rate. Will send after 15m if stable.

mike: Filing a short incident stub and timeline in #incidents; will expand to postmortem if this meets post-incident criteria.

incident-bot: PD12345 acknowledged by mike. Escalation suppressed. Auto-close window set to 1h if metrics remain within SLO.

mike: Thanks team — great quick coordination. Follow-ups: (1) re-enable autoscale, (2) postmortem + root cause (autoscale disabled + tokenizer backlog), (3) add playbook step to auto-route when regional autoscale disabled.

sara: Adding playbook note now.

emily: I'll coordinate CS follow-up and customer notes.

(ended)
